title: CoverStory Days 127–140 local restore rehearsal and offline AWS permission gate
outcome: Restore the existing synthetic application into a fresh local PostgreSQL database, compare its retained business/recovery evidence, and rehearse reversible quiesced configuration cutover; AWS stays an offline design only.
constraints: Only fixture-owned source/target databases and loopback processes; target is fresh template0 and never pre-migrated or Flyway-seeded.
Use real PostgreSQL 18.6 pg_dump/pg_restore custom archive tools from pinned official postgres:18.6 image; record tool/server versions.
No --clean/--create, arbitrary URLs, source overwrite, production credentials/data, AWS CLI/SDK/resources, or public exposure.
Restore preserves V001–V005 schema, Flyway history, lifecycle/idempotency/work/receipt/quarantine/history payloads and timestamps.
Same-artifact quiesced configuration rollback only; candidate writes block blind fallback to stale source. No schema or binary rollback claim.
AWS plan is offline/non-deployable with fictional rates only; cloud execution not authorized/performed.
Recovery days 133 and 140 review prior work only. DSA is actual-attempt queue first; no new anchor/completion inferred.
